newsitem.title: USA: U.S. debt futures stumble late, end down slightly.
newsitem.headline: U.S. debt futures stumble late, end down slightly.

text.p: Oct 21 - U.S. debt futures stumbled late to end lower after dealer selling and selling by a prominent local pressed the market. Traders said three firms sold 1,000 each in Dec T-bonds late, jarring the market from the morning slumber. The market had been caught near steady amid a dearth of news and ahead of midweek auctions.
